race.comment: LAND BANK (14) stripped fitter and enjoyed the step up in distance last start when successful over 1350m here in a midweek Class 3. Tackling a better field this time and is new to 1600m but he is a lightly raced five-year-old heading the right way. Looks up to the task. LUTON HOO (3) continued her strong form this prep with an eye-catching fourth over 1630m at this circuit. Up a little in grade but drops 3kgs after the claim and draws the fence. Right in contention again. CAPE BYRON (7) was strong at the end of 1400m at Rosehill last start. That Sydney form is gold in Brisbane of late so he must go in the numbers. LARRIKIN ROGUE (4) has not won since May 2023 but his best recent efforts give him an each-way hope.
